comments: Works in current Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari (uses pdf.js in the page). Single-document checker: it reads one PDF at a time. I maintain this tool.
features: Free in-browser first-pass check for PDFs; files are never uploaded. Flags missing tags, document title and display setting, document language, image-only (scanned) pages, missing heading tags, figures without alt text and tables without header cells. A pass is not proof of conformance: follow up with manual testing and a PDF/UA validator.
title: SignalFeed PDF Accessibility Quick Check
